name: sabaq
description: Sabaq - AI Learning Experience Engine (UBL Digital HR & AI Manager assignment)

scripts.build:api: npm run build:engine && npm run build --workspace @sabaq/api
scripts.build:web: npm run build:engine && npm run build --workspace @sabaq/web
scripts.build: npm run build:engine && npm run build --workspace @sabaq/api && npm run build --workspace @sabaq/web
scripts.dev:api: npm run build:engine && npm run dev --workspace @sabaq/api
scripts.dev:web: npm run build:engine && npm run dev --workspace @sabaq/web
scripts.dev: npm run build:engine && concurrently -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev --workspace @sabaq/api" "npm run dev --workspace @sabaq/web"
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:engine && tsc -p apps/api/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p apps/web/tsconfig.json --noEmit
